//: One server, serving every tool the CLI registers. Relative path, because a project-scoped .mcp.json resolves against the project root - which is the one place these tools mean anything: they read this repository's Markdown, its templates, and the shards committed beside the CLI. No token, no service, no network. The count is deliberately not written here; it said eighteen while the server registered twenty-two, and `adam-jurek mcp` is what knows.
